Cites a thread on the [http://www.bay12forums.com/smf/ Bay 12 Games forum].

First parameter format (only needed for definitions):
<pre>
{{cite forum|1}}
</pre>
&rarr; {{cite forum|1}}
<pre>
{{cite forum|1/1}}
</pre>
&rarr; {{cite forum|1/1}}

This uses {{tl|forum link/url}} to retrieve the URL internally - see the [[template:forum link|documentation]] for more information on acceptable formats.
